What customers are saying

Customers overwhelmingly praise this monitor for exceptional value, outstanding display quality, and effortless setup. Most highlight excellent brightness and clarity in well-lit rooms with minimal glare, plus an appreciated eye saver feature for comfort. Many note the seamless installation completed in under an hour and commend the included HDMI cable as a thoughtful bonus. Reviewers consistently report the performance and features exceed expectations for the price. A few experienced issues like hardware damage or connectivity problems, and some found it slightly larger than anticipated. Overall, most customers consider it an excellent investment that delivers reliable performance and quality.

This summary is generated by AI using customer reviews from multiple languages and translated into English.

    Reviewed by Doogie Howser - March 15, 2026

    1. I bought two of these, because the sale price was great, the reviews were good, the AI said it was a steal and I have a Samsung phone, which I love. And they work fine, except the power and monitor control functions are in the back about a third from the bottom, so if you wish to turn off these monitors at night an extended frustrating reach is required and then maintained to hold down the button for a number of seconds. And when turned on an irritating screen message is displayed for several seconds, that can't be clicked on, requiring a QR code to register the warranty.
